intro.text: Vathi's Aviar, a small white-and-green bird who is hurt when Dusk first finds the pair on Patji.

items.text: Mirris was already wounded when Dusk came upon her with Vathi in Patji's jungle, and she rode on Vathi's shoulder as he led them to his safecamp.
At the safecamp, as he and Vathi tended the birds, Dusk cleaned Mirris's wounds.

Dusk was glad Vathi had given her some first aid. Thinking her wing broken, he bound her wings and settled her among his own Aviar, and she stayed behind to heal while Dusk and Vathi went out to investigate the Company.

Mirris went with Vathi to many meetings about the Ones Above and the Eelakin's future. She also travelled with her back to Patji and through Patji's Eye, which she disliked, to see Dusk off, and was with her again when he came home.

appearance.text: About three fists tall, with soft white and green plumage, she is of a breed found on some islands of the Pantheon but not on Patji.

personality.text: Hurt, she turns on strangers, hissing at Dusk and Kokerlii even while Dusk is tending her. Vathi calms her with clicking sounds.
When safe she is affectionate and motherly, both with Rokke and with Dusk.

items.text: Through her Nahel bond with Vathi, she lets Vathi hide all thought in the area around her.
